questions.question: Why did we choose a claimable lane queue instead of md5 sharding for the backfill drivers?
questions.key: D41 / ADR-026: static md5(project_key)%SHARDS measured a 4/14/6/7 split (~3.5x skew), no work-stealing, no reliable crash recovery; pipeline_work claim query gives work-stealing + lease-expiry recovery; separate lanes target the 119s->710s LLM-lane degradation
questions.grade: correct = skew/imbalance or no work-stealing AND crash-recovery/lease; partial = one reason

questions.question: What happened to doc_vision.py and why?
questions.key: D45/ADR-030 deleted it (cannot import the banned AGPL pymupdf; 6,041 run_carpet_vision items closed skipped-by-policy); D-101 (2026-08-24) reversed that: ported to pypdfium2 + pypdf and restored; DECISIONS §D: measured 2026-09-14 the revival never completed — rera_scraper/doc_vision.py exists but is DORMANT (zero callers, zero tests), open ruling: connect or delete under FR-101
questions.grade: correct = AGPL/pymupdf removal AND the D-101 port/restore (module exists now, dormant or not); partial = only the D45 deletion story or only the port
